quests.instruction: Sofia is about to ride her bike. What should she wear on her head to stay safe?
quests.hint: It protects her head in a fall.
quests.explanation: A helmet has a hard shell and soft padding. It protects your head if you fall.
quests.funFact: A helmet should sit level on your head and fit snugly.

quests.instruction: Which part of a jacket can be pulled up to cover your head?
quests.hint: It is attached at the back of the neck.
quests.explanation: A hood is a piece of fabric attached to the neck of a jacket. You can pull it up over your head.
quests.funFact: Hoods are handy when you forget your hat.

quests.instruction: A baseball cap has a stiff piece sticking out in front. What does it help with?
quests.correctAnswer: Shading your eyes from the sun ☀️
options: Shading your eyes from the sun ☀️
quests.hint: Focus on where the sun shines from.
quests.explanation: The brim makes a small shadow over your eyes, so sunlight does not glare as much.
quests.funFact: The front part of a cap is called the brim or the visor.

quests.instruction: A sweater is a piece of clothing for one part of the body. Which part is it?
quests.hint: Sleeves go on arms.
quests.explanation: Sweaters cover the chest, back, and arms. That is the upper body.
quests.funFact: The torso is the middle part of your body between your neck and your hips.

quests.instruction: Tomás pulls on pants in the morning. What part of his body is he covering?
quests.hint: Pants have two tubes.
quests.explanation: Pants cover the legs from the waist down, so they are lower-body clothing.
quests.funFact: Some pants have legs that can zip off to become shorts.

quests.instruction: Kofi's long-sleeved shirt covers a lot of his body. Which parts do the sleeves cover?
quests.hint: Sleeves are tubes for one body part.
quests.explanation: Sleeves are tubes of fabric that cover your arms. Short sleeves cover the top part and long sleeves cover all of it.
quests.funFact: Sleeve length can be short, three-quarter, or long.

quests.instruction: Why do we usually wear socks inside our shoes?
quests.correctAnswer: They cushion our feet and soak up sweat 🧦
options: They help shoes stay tied tightly 🪢
They stop rain from getting into shoes 🌧️
They cushion our feet and soak up sweat 🧦
quests.hint: Your feet get warm and damp in shoes.
quests.explanation: Socks protect your feet from rubbing and absorb sweat, which helps prevent sore spots and smells.
quests.funFact: Your feet have thousands of tiny sweat glands.

quests.instruction: Which footwear covers the whole foot and goes up around the ankle?
quests.hint: Open shoes leave the toes bare.
quests.explanation: Boots cover the whole foot and the ankle too, so they give more protection than open shoes.
quests.funFact: Work boots often have a tough toe to protect feet from heavy things.

quests.instruction: Why does a shoe have a thick, hard bottom called a sole?
quests.correctAnswer: It protects the foot from the ground 🦶
options: It keeps laces from coming loose 🪢
It protects the foot from the ground 🦶
It helps the shoe stay shiny ✨
quests.hint: Remember what you step on.
quests.explanation: The sole sits between your foot and the ground. It protects against stones, hot pavement, and rough surfaces.
quests.funFact: Many soles have grooves called treads, which help shoes grip.

quests.instruction: Mia's glove has five narrow tubes inside. What are they for?
quests.hint: Count how many tubes there are.
quests.explanation: Each narrow tube holds one finger. Gloves let you move each finger separately.
quests.funFact: Fingerless gloves leave the fingertips open so you can use buttons or write.

quests.instruction: Which clothing keeps all your fingers together and has one separate space for the thumb?
quests.hint: Your fingers share one big space.
quests.explanation: Mittens keep your fingers close together in one roomy space, which helps them share warmth.
quests.funFact: Many people find mittens warmer than gloves for this reason.

quests.instruction: Which part of a shirt wraps around the neck?
quests.hint: Consider where your neck is.
quests.explanation: The collar sits around your neck. Some shirts have a folded collar and others have a plain round neckline.
quests.funFact: The fold of a shirt collar is sometimes called the 'collar fold'.

quests.instruction: Why does a sun hat with a wide brim help at the beach?
quests.correctAnswer: It shades the face and neck 🌞
options: It cools the air around your legs 🌬️
It shades the face and neck 🌞
It keeps sand off your feet 🦶
quests.hint: Remember where the sun shines.
quests.explanation: A wide brim makes shade around your face and neck, which helps protect your skin from sunburn.
quests.funFact: Some sun hats are also made from fabric that blocks harmful sun rays.

quests.instruction: Diego is carrying rough wooden boards outside. What can protect his hands from splinters?
quests.hint: Splinters are tiny sharp bits of wood.
quests.explanation: Thick work gloves are a barrier between wood and skin, so splinters are less likely to get in.
quests.funFact: Work gloves come in different thicknesses for different jobs.

quests.instruction: Priya is hiking through tall grass with thorny bushes. Which outfit protects her arms and legs best?
quests.hint: Focus on what covers more skin.
quests.explanation: Long sleeves and long pants cover skin, so thorns and grass scratch the fabric and not the skin.
quests.funFact: Hikers also check their clothes for ticks after walking in tall grass.

quests.instruction: Which top covers the most of your arms?
quests.hint: Look at the sleeves.
quests.explanation: A long-sleeved shirt covers your arms down to the wrists. A T-shirt covers only the top, and a tank top covers none.
quests.funFact: Sleeve length is one of the easiest ways to tell shirts apart.

quests.instruction: Kai scrapes his knees a lot when he falls on the playground. Which choice would cover his knees?
quests.hint: The answer goes on the legs and goes below the knee.
quests.explanation: Long pants cover knees. Shorts leave knees bare, so a fall can scrape the skin.
quests.funFact: Some children's pants have reinforced knees for extra strength.

quests.instruction: Which of these shoes covers the toes and the heel completely?
quests.hint: Closed means no open sides.
quests.explanation: Sneakers are closed shoes. They cover the whole foot, while flip-flops and sandals leave parts bare.
quests.funFact: Closed shoes are usually recommended for running or playing sports.

quests.instruction: What does a belt help pants do?
quests.hint: Focus on where a belt goes.
quests.explanation: A belt pulls the waistband snug so pants stay at your waist and do not slide down.
quests.funFact: Belts have a row of holes so you can choose how tight to make them.

quests.instruction: What do shoelaces help a shoe do?
quests.hint: Think about pulling and tying.
quests.explanation: Pulling the laces tight and tying them keeps a shoe firmly on your foot so it does not slip when you walk.
quests.funFact: A double knot helps stop laces from coming undone while you play.

quests.instruction: Why does a shirt have buttons down the front?
quests.correctAnswer: So it opens wide, then closes up 🔘
options: So it opens wide, then closes up 🔘
So it can keep rain out 🌧️
So it can stretch as you grow 📈
quests.hint: Think about getting your head and arms through.
quests.explanation: An opening with buttons lets you put a shirt on easily and then fasten it closed.
quests.funFact: Buttons were used on clothing long before zippers were invented.

quests.instruction: Hat, cap, and hood all go on the same part of the body. Which other item goes there too?
quests.hint: They all protect the head.
quests.explanation: A helmet is also worn on the head. A scarf goes around the neck and a belt at the waist.
quests.funFact: Helmets are made for protection, while hats are usually for warmth or shade.

quests.instruction: Socks, boots, and slippers all go on the feet. Which other item goes on the feet?
quests.hint: Consider the body part: foot.
quests.explanation: Sandals cover feet, just like boots and slippers. Gloves go on the hands and a scarf goes on the neck.
quests.funFact: Slippers are made for walking around inside the house.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item is made to sit at the waist?
quests.hint: The waist is the middle of your body.
quests.explanation: A belt wraps around the waist, between the upper and lower body.
quests.funFact: The waistband on pants is the part that sits at your waist.

quests.instruction: Why do some jackets have shiny reflective strips?
quests.correctAnswer: Drivers can see you in the dark 🚗
options: Drivers can see you in the dark 🚗
quests.hint: Think about car headlights.
quests.explanation: Reflective strips bounce light back from headlights, so drivers can notice people who are walking or biking at night.
quests.funFact: Reflective strips look dull in daylight but bright when a flashlight shines on them.

quests.instruction: Why do swimmers usually wear swimsuits instead of jeans in the pool?
quests.correctAnswer: Swimsuits are light and dry quickly 🩱
options: Swimsuits keep you warmer than jeans 🔥
Swimsuits are light and dry quickly 🩱
Jeans are too short for swimming 📏
quests.hint: Consider what happens to heavy, wet clothes.
quests.explanation: Swimsuits are light and made to dry fast. Jeans soak up water, get heavy, and make it harder to move.
quests.funFact: Water-soaked jeans can feel much heavier than dry ones.

quests.instruction: A winter hat pulls down over the ears. What does that help with?
quests.hint: Ears are small, so they get cold quickly.
quests.explanation: Ears have little fat to keep them warm, so a hat that covers them helps on cold days.
quests.funFact: Ears, fingers, and noses get cold first because they are far from the center of your body.

quests.instruction: Mei is going sledding in snow. Which group of items covers her head, hands, and feet?
quests.hint: Three different body areas, all for cold.
quests.explanation: A hat covers the head, mittens cover the hands, and boots cover the feet. Together they protect the body parts that cool fastest.
quests.funFact: Extra layers on the head, hands, and feet are important in very cold weather.

quests.instruction: Ben put on his helmet and tied his shoes. What activity is he probably getting ready for?
quests.hint: One item protects the head, the other stays on feet.
quests.explanation: A helmet protects your head and tied shoes stay on while pedaling. Both are part of a safe bike ride.
quests.funFact: Always check that shoelaces are tucked in so they do not catch in the bike chain.

quests.instruction: Aisha's pants keep falling down at the waist. Which item can help?
quests.hint: It goes around the middle.
quests.explanation: A belt holds pants at the waist and keeps them from slipping while you move.
quests.funFact: Elastic waistbands also stretch to hold pants up without a belt.
